node_path.description: Node executable path; empty uses PATH or the known local runtime

browser_profile.description: Absolute path of a dedicated, manually logged-in Edge profile

allowed_user_ids.description: Allowed chat sender IDs; empty permits private-chat draft preview only. Group chats are disabled.

allow_publish.description: Enable real public text posts after the owning user sends /weibo_confirm. Requires a non-empty allowed_user_ids list. Posts select the AI-generated declaration.
